sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL ASSUME AN INCREASING ELY COMPONENT TODAY ALONG THE STALLING FRONT IN RESPONSE TO THE DEVELOPING LEE CYCLONE OVER ERN WY. THIS WILL PROMOTE THE WWD FLUX OF A MORE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER INTO THE HIGH TERRAIN WHILE AT THE SAME TIME ENHANCING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON WITHIN THE ELY UPSLOPE REGIME AND IMMEDIATE COOL SIDE OF THE FRONT ALONG THE MT-WY BORDER AS DEEP-LAYER ASCENT IS AUGMENTED BY THE POLAR-BRANCH SHORT-WAVE TROUGH. THE COMBINATION OF STEEP LAPSE RATES AND INCREASING LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH EWD EXTENT SHOULD YIELD SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY AMIDST 50-60 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR TO SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A BRIEF TORNADO IS ALSO POSSIBLE. STORMS MAY CONGEAL INTO AN MCS LATER THIS EVENING WITH A DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THREAT SPREADING EWD INTO WRN SD.

sections.title: FL THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: 12Z SOUNDING DATA INDICATE THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST AND ALREADY MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IN PLACE. TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED THIS MORNING FROM THE BAHAMAS WWD INTO THE FAR SRN PENINSULA IN ASSOCIATION WITH A VORTICITY MAXIMUM THAT WILL PROGRESS NNWWD ALONG OR JUST OFFSHORE OF THE ERN PENINSULAR COAST. FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE WILL AUGMENT LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG THE DEVELOPING SEA-BREEZE FRONTS TO FOSTER NUMEROUS STORMS BY AFTERNOON THAT WILL HAVE A TENDENCY TO AMALGAMATE INTO WWD-MOVING CLUSTERS. LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD WITH THESE STORMS.

sections.title: OZARKS/MID MS VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: SIMILAR TO THE SETUP OVER S-CNTRL KS ON MONDAY...DAYTIME HEATING AND BOUNDARY-LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL ALIGN WITH COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES TO YIELD WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY FROM THE VICINITY OF THE SURFACE LOW EWD/NEWD ALONG THE OCCLUDED FRONT. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK OWING TO THE CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE DEEP-LAYER CYCLONE. HOWEVER...GIVEN A VORTICITY-RICH ENVIRONMENT AND THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURE PROFILES...A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO AND/OR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE. ..MEAD/ROGERS.. 06/10/2014

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF STRONG WINDS AND PERHAPS A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE LIKELY FROM SOUTHERN PARTS OF THE OHIO VALLEY TO CENTRAL GULF COAST. ELSEWHERE...ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE OVER PARTS OF NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: OH VALLEY THROUGH CNTRL GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: ONGOING FORECAST APPEARS TO BE ON TRACK WITH SQUALL LINE POSING A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AS IT CONTINUES THROUGH ERN KY...ERN TN...ERN AL...WRN AND NRN GA AND EVENTUALLY INTO THE WRN CAROLINAS. HAVE SHIFTED THE 5% TORNADO PROBABILITIES INTO ERN KY WHERE A FEW DISCRETE CELLS ARE DEVELOPING AHEAD OF THE LINE AND WHERE DEEP SHEAR AROUND 40 KT IS SUPPORTIVE OF UPDRAFT ROTATION AND MAYBE A TORNADO OR TWO...THOUGH LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS ARE NOT PARTICULARLY LARGE WHICH SHOULD SERVE AS A LIMITING FACTOR. ACTIVITY SHOULD BEGIN A GENERAL DECREASE THIS EVENING WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: NO CHANGES TO FORECAST IN THIS REGION. STORMS INITIATION OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN WILL CONTINUE EWD WITHIN DEVELOPING POST-FRONTAL UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME WHERE 40-45 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND 500-1000 MLCAPE WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR SUPERCELLS. ACTIVITY MAY EVENTUALLY CONGEAL INTO A COUPLE OF CLUSTERS. DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS THROUGH MID EVENING. ..DIAL.. 06/10/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1121 AM CDT TUE JUN 10 2014/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND POSSIBLY A BRIEF TORNADO SHOULD INCREASE BY LATE MORNING/MIDDAY MAINLY ACROSS FAR SOUTHEAST MS INTO SOUTHWEST/WEST-CENTRAL AL AND PERHAPS PARTS OF EASTERN LA. PENDING DEVELOPMENT TRENDS...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS POSSIBLE FOR PARTS OF THE REGION /MOST PROBABLE ACROSS AL/ BY MIDDAY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MODESTLY-INTENSE SQUALL LINE CONTINUES AN EASTWARD PROGRESSION ACROSS SOUTHERN MS AND MUCH OF SOUTHERN LA AS OF 1445Z...WITH THE FASTEST EASTWARD PROGRESSION OCCURRING ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL MS AT AROUND 30 KT. WHILE SOME THICKER CLOUD COVER IMMEDIATELY PRECEDES THE SQUALL LINE...THE SQUALL-LINE PRECEDING AIR MASS CONTINUES TO WARM COINCIDENT WITH AMPLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE /PREVALENT LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/. WITH INHIBITION ALREADY VIRTUALLY NIL...STORM INTENSIFICATION IS PROBABLE INTO LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON...PERHAPS ESPECIALLY NEAR/JUST SOUTH OF AN OUTFLOW-INDUCED POINT OF INFLECTION ACROSS SOUTHEAST MS INTO AL WHILE SHOWERS/SOME TSTMS ALSO CONTINUE TO INCREASE AHEAD OF THE LINE. THIS POTENTIAL INTENSIFICATION WILL BE AS UPWARDS OF 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE IS INCREASINGLY REALIZED /REFERENCE 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM SLIDELL LA/. ALTHOUGH THE STRONGEST DEEP-LAYER WINDS WILL SOMEWHAT LAG THE SQUALL LINE...QUASI-LINEAR ORGANIZATION WILL BE AIDED BY AN INCREASINGLY STRONG BELT OF SOUTHWESTERLY MID-LEVEL WINDS /ESPECIALLY MS AND AL NORTHWARD/ IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE BASE OF THE UPSTREAM TROUGH...ASIDE FROM SOME INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED INTENSIFY THROUGH LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS CENTRAL/NORTHERN AL AND MIDDLE TN INTO PARTS OF EASTERN TN AND CENTRAL/EASTERN KY...AND POSSIBLY PORTIONS FAR SOUTHERN INDIANA. DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREAT...ALTHOUGH A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE AS WELL. ONE OR MORE WATCHES ARE LIKELY ACROSS THE REGION BY EARLY AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FRAGMENTED BOWING-PORTION OF A BROAD SQUALL LINE CONTINUES TO STEADILY SPREAD NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL TN...AS FAST AS 40-45 KT AS OF 1515Z. WHILE THIS PORTION OF THE LINE IS LIKELY STILL SLIGHTLY ELEVATED...OVER TIME...A WARMING/MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER /ESPECIALLY AS TEMPS APPROACH THE MIDDLE 70S F/ COULD LEAD TO INTENSIFICATION AND/OR ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT...ESPECIALLY ACROSS PARTS OF TN/KY INTO THE AFTERNOON. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AT MID-MORNING SHOWS A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY CLOUD-FREE SKIES ACROSS MIDDLE TN INTO EAST-CENTRAL KY TO THE SOUTH OF NORTHWARD-ADVANCING WARM FRONT. ALTHOUGH OVERALL DESTABILIZATION WILL REMAIN MODEST /SUB-1000 J PER KG MLCAPE/...AN INCREASINGLY STRONG/LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND FIELD WILL SUPPORT DAMAGING WIND/ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL. FARTHER SOUTH...AN INCIPIENT TREND OF INTENSIFICATION MAY ALREADY BE OCCURRING ACROSS PARTS OF FAR WESTERN/NORTHWEST AL AS OF 1530Z FOCUSED ALONG/IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF COMPOSITE OUTFLOW. CONTEMPORARY MODIFICATIONS TO THE 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM BIRMINGHAM...TO ACCOUNT FOR LOWER 80S F SURFACE TEMPERATURES ACROSS CENTRAL AL AT 15Z...INDICATE NEGLIGIBLE INHIBITION WITH AROUND 2300 J/KG OF MLCAPE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO AND MAINLY SUB-SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL/EASTERN MO TO SOUTHWEST IL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SHOWERS/TSTMS ARE LIKELY TO CONTINUE TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE REGION IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO A NEARLY VERTICALLY STACKED UPPER LOW CENTERED ACROSS SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL MO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE THIS CYCLONE IS IN A STAGE OF OCCLUSION...STEEPENING OF LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODEST DESTABILIZATION UNDER THE UPPER COLD POCKET /-13C AT 500MB/ CONTINUES TO OCCUR IN AN ARCING CORRIDOR ON THE PERIPHERY OF THE SURFACE LOW. IN THE PRESENCE OF AMBIENT VERTICAL VORTICITY...SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE NEAR THE SURFACE OCCLUSION/WIND SHIFT WILL COINCIDE WITH UPWARDS OF 100-125 J/KG OF 0-3 KM CAPE. AS SUCH...FUNNELS AND A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO...ASIDE FROM MAINLY SUB-SEVERE HAIL...WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS AREAS INCLUDING CENTRAL/EASTERN MO TO SOUTHWEST IL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE POTENTIAL IN THE FORM OF DAMAGING WINDS ALONG WITH SOME HAIL/ISOLATED TORNADO RISK IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE THROUGH EARLY/MID-AFTERNOON ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN KY. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT A WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED PRIOR TO 1830Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FRAGMENTED SQUALL LINE/RESIDUAL COLD POOL CONTINUES TO STEADILY MOVE NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS CENTRAL KY/MIDDLE TN AS OF 18Z...WITH A PRECEDING SUPERCELL NOTED ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL TN. THE BOUNDARY LAYER PRECEDING THIS ACTIVITY ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN KY CONTINUES TO STEADILY WARM/MOISTEN TO THE SOUTH OF A WARM FRONT LOCATED NEAR THE OH RIVER. ACCOUNTING FOR UPPER 70S/LOWER 80S F SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND 60S DEWPOINTS...ANY REMAINING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IS ESSENTIALLY GONE...WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED TO BE AROUND/JUST ABOVE 500 J/KG. STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES/ADEQUATE BUOYANCY...IN THE PRESENCE OF STRENGTHENING DEEP LAYER SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS ABOVE THE SURFACE WILL ALLOW FOR A COMBINATION OF SUSTAINED/RELATIVELY FAST-MOVING LINEAR SEGMENTS AND A FEW PRECEDING SUPERCELLS. REGARDING THE DEGREE OF SHEAR...LATEST WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM HOPKINSVILLE KY IS SHOWING 0-3 KM SHEAR AROUND 40KT AND 0-6 KM SHEAR OF NEARLY 50 KT. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERN...BUT A TORNADO OR TWO...ALONG WITH SOME HAIL...WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS SOUTHEAST LA AND EXTREME SOUTHEAST MS INTO SOUTHERN AL. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 274 CONTINUES UNTIL 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS OF 1815Z...THE INTEGRITY OF THE PRIMARY COLD POOL/EASTWARD-ADVANCING SQUALL LINE HAS DIMINISHED OVER THE PAST HOUR OR SO...LIKELY IN CONJUNCTION WITH WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND WEAKER VERTICAL SHEAR WITH EASTWARD EXTENT. HOWEVER...SOME PRECEDING STORM DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING MAINLY ACROSS SOUTHERN AL AND SOME INTENSIFICATION REMAINS POSSIBLE AHEAD OF THE RESIDUAL COLD POOL/OUTFLOW. THE DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS ACROSS FAR SOUTHEAST LA AND SOUTHERN AL/FL PANHANDLE REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE/WEAKLY INHIBITED WITH MLCAPE AS HIGH AS 2500 J/KG. ..GUYER.. 06/10/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE OVER THE BLUE RIDGE MTNS IS FORECAST TO INCREASE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND EXPAND EWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN/CNTRL VA. PRIMARY THREAT WITH THESE STORMS WILL BE ISOLATED STRONG TO PERHAPS MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS...BUT THIS THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE INSUFFICIENT FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS LITTLE IN THE WAY OF CLOUD COVER ACROSS MUCH OF CNTRL VA...WITH POCKETS OF INCREASING CU OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WRN VA WITHIN THE PAST 1-2 HRS. A WEAK BOUNDARY WAS ALSO NOTED FROM 40 SW MRB TO 10 E CHO AND ARCING BACK EWD TO 10 N RIC...WITH RELATIVELY MORE MOIST AND SLIGHTLY COOLER SFC CONDITIONS NOTED TO THE N OF THE BOUNDARY. NEVERTHELESS...STRONG DIURNAL HEATING IS YIELDING TEMPERATURES IN THE MID-80S AMIDST A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...CHARACTERIZED BY DEWPOINTS RANGING FROM THE MID-60 TO LOWER-70S F. ENHANCED OROGRAPHIC AND PBL CIRCULATIONS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF ISOLATED-SCATTERED TSTMS INTO THE MID-AFTERNOON...EVENTUALLY SPREADING EWD ACROSS CNTRL PORTIONS OF VA...BUT COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO BE LIMITED DUE TO WEAK LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT IN THE PRESENCE OF MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE RIDGING. HOWEVER...WITH STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING DCAPE VALUES NEAR 1000 J/KG...AND A BELT OF MODERATE MIDLEVEL FLOW OF 20-30 KT POSITIONED OVERHEAD...A FEW ORGANIZED CLUSTERS COULD MATERIALIZE AND SUPPORT STRONG WIND GUSTS. THE THREAT FOR HAIL IS EXPECTED TO BE MORE LIMITED DUE TO RELATIVELY WARM TEMPERATURES ALOFT AND MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL IS LIKELY TO CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS EASTERN AL/MIDDLE TN TO EASTERN TN AND WEST/NORTH GA TO THE FAR WESTERN CAROLINAS THIS AFTERNOON. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 273 CONTINUES UNTIL 23Z. AN ADDITIONAL WATCH IS LIKELY /80+ PERCENT/ ACROSS PARTS OF GA/EASTERN TN AND THE FAR WESTERN CAROLINAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN EXTENSIVE NORTH-SOUTH SQUALL LINE...ALONG WITH PRECEDING STORMS...HAS SHOWN SIGNS OF GENERAL INTENSIFICATION/MODEST EAST-NORTHEASTWARD ACCELERATION EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AS IT MOVES ACROSS MIDDLE TN/EASTERN AL. A 46 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY /1835Z/ MEASURED AT ALBERTVILLE AL. TRENDS IN SURFACE DATA GENERALLY INDICATE THAT PRE-SQUALL LINE CONVERGENCE HAS SOMEWHAT INCREASED VIA A TREND TOWARD SOUTH-SOUTHEASTERLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS COINCIDENT WITH A CORRIDOR OF 2+ MB/2-HR PRESSURE FALLS...WHICH ARE MAXIMIZED ACROSS NORTHEAST AL/NORTHWEST GA. AHEAD OF THE SQUALL LINE...UPPER 70S AND 80S F SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS ARE CONTRIBUTING TO 1000-2500 J/KG MLCAPE /HIGHEST ACROSS AL INTO GA/. INDICATIVE OF THE STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER/NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS ABOVE THE SURFACE...LATEST WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM BIRMINGHAM IN THE IMMEDIATE WAKE OF THE SQUALL LINE IS SHOWING SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS AS STRONG AS 50 KT BETWEEN 2-4 KM AGL. IN ALL...DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL SHOULD FURTHER INCREASE AS THE SQUALL LINE GRADUALLY ACCELERATES EAST-NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH MID/LATE AFTERNOON. ..GUYER.. 06/10/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE THROUGH MID-AFTERNOON ACROSS S-CNTRL MT/N-CNTRL WY AND EVENTUALLY EWD INTO SERN MT/NERN WY...AND PERHAPS AS FAR E AS THE WRN DAKOTAS BY THIS EVENING. AN ACCOMPANYING THREAT FOR SVR WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL MAY INCREASE AS WELL...AND COULD REQUIRE WW ISSUANCE WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED AND LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH QUICKLY PROGRESSING EWD ACROSS SRN ID. BELT OF RELATIVELY ENHANCED MIDLEVEL MOISTENING AND ASCENT PRECEDING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...ALONG WITH MODEST DESTABILIZATION AND STRENGTHENING OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS...ARE CONTRIBUTING TO TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS PRIMARILY THE HIGHER TERRAIN AREAS OF SWRN MT...ERN ID...AND NWRN WY. DESPITE SOMEWHAT LIMITED BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE IN THE PRESENCE OF THIS CONVECTION...ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS N OF A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT /ANALYZED FROM SWRN MT ESEWD INTO CNTRL WY/ ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS ARE CONTRIBUTING TO GRADUAL MOISTENING /CHARACTERIZED BY MID-40S F DEWPOINTS/...AND SHOULD RESULT IN A MORE FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR STORM SUSTENANCE/ORGANIZATION DOWNSHEAR INTO PORTIONS OF S-CNTRL MT AND N-CNTRL WY. STRONG MIDLEVEL WINDS /40-50 KT/ WILL FAVOR STORM ORGANIZATION...ESPECIALLY IN VICINITY AND TO THE N OF THE FRONT WHERE ELY WINDS WILL ENHANCE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS...WITH THE LATTER THREAT ENHANCED WITH ANY CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS THAT MAY EVOLVE LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUST OR TWO REMAINS POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTH-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST AL...BUT THE OVERALL SEVERE RISK IN/NEAR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 274 SHOULD REMAIN LIMITED THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. NO ADDITIONAL WATCHES ARE ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITHIN A MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR ENVIRONMENT...ISOLATED/EPISODIC WIND DAMAGE WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHERN AL WITHIN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. HOWEVER...CONSEQUENTIAL REDEVELOPMENT OR INTENSIFICATION IS UNLIKELY AS THE EARLIER SQUALL LINE HAS OTHERWISE WEAKENED WITH EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ADVANCING OUTFLOW. AS SUCH...THE OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL IN/NEAR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 274 SHOULD CONTINUE TO DIMINISH AND NO ADDITIONAL WATCHES ARE ANTICIPATED. ..GUYER.. 06/10/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND PERHAPS A TORNADO MAY INCREASE ACROSS ADDITIONAL PARTS OF NORTHEAST KY INTO SOUTHERN OH THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. DEVELOPMENTAL TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN SQUALL LINE WITH INCREASING SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF IT WILL CONTINUE A GENERAL NORTHEASTWARD ADVANCEMENT ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL KY AND POSSIBLY INTO SOUTHERN OH THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. A WARM FRONT CONTINUES TO SLOWLY SHIFT NORTHWARD ALONG THE OH RIVER...WITH A CORRESPONDING NORTHWARD-SHIFT OF MODEST INSTABILITY /500 J PER KG MLCAPE/ OCCURRING ACROSS MUCH OF EAST-CENTRAL KY AND FAR SOUTHWEST OH AS OF 20Z. AIDED BY STRENGTHENING SOUTHWESTERLY DEEP LAYER FLOW PER REGIONAL WSR-88D VWP DATA...IT SEEMS PLAUSIBLE THAT AT LEAST AN ISOLATED SEVERE RISK...POTENTIALLY INCLUDING DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL...MAY DEVELOP NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS ADDITIONAL PORTIONS OF NORTHEAST KY/SOUTHERN OH THROUGH EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY EXIST ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF SERN WY INTO THE WRN NEB PANHANDLE AND FAR SWRN SD THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. THE ISOLATED/MARGINAL NATURE OF THE THREAT WILL PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS ARE INCREASING ACROSS S-CNTRL WY IN RESPONSE TO A GLANCING INFLUENCE OF A SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH MOVING ACROSS THE INTER-MOUNTAIN WEST...AND AN ACCOMPANYING RIBBON OF ENHANCED MIDLEVEL MOISTURE OVERSPREADING THE REGION. BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE IS MEAGER...BUT STRONG DIURNAL HEATING AMIDST A STEEP LAPSE RATE PROFILE IS YIELDING MARGINAL DESTABILIZATION WITH MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED AT 250-750 J/KG. WITH 30-40 KT OF WLY MIDLEVEL FLOW POSITIONED OVERHEAD...TSTMS SHOULD PROGRESS EWD OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EARLY EVENING. DESPITE A WEAKNESS IN LOW-LEVEL FLOW...20-30 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR MARGINAL TSTM ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE INTO THE EARLY EVENING...AND DCAPE VALUES AOA 1500 J/KG WILL BE SUPPORTIVE FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...COVERAGE WILL BE LIMITED BY WEAK LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT...AND THE MARGINAL NATURE OF THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS REMAINS THE PRIMARY RISK FROM EAST-CENTRAL AL AND WEST/NORTH GA INTO EASTERN KY/TN AND WESTERN CAROLINAS. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCHES 273/275/276 CONTINUE UNTIL 23Z/01Z/03Z RESPECTIVELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPOSITE SQUALL LINE CONTINUES A GENERAL NORTHEASTWARD ADVANCEMENT ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL PORTIONS OF KY/TN AND EAST-CENTRAL AL/NORTH GA AS OF 21Z. AIR MASS AHEAD OF THE SQUALL LINE REMAINS WARM/INCREASINGLY MOIST AND GENERALLY MODERATELY UNSTABLE...WITH MLCAPE RANGING FROM 750-1000 J/KG ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL PORTIONS OF KY/TN TO UPWARDS OF 1500-2250 J/KG ACROSS NORTH/WEST-CENTRAL GA AND FAR EASTERN AL. REGIONAL WSR-88D VWP DATA SHOWS THAT DEEP LAYER/NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS CONTINUE TO INCREASE...PARTICULARLY WITH NORTHERN EXTENT ACROSS KY/TN. IN ALL...DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY CONCERN THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS AS THE SQUALL LINE CONTINUES EAST-NORTHEASTWARD. ..GUYER.. 06/10/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST RISK FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS SHOULD EVOLVE FROM THE MOST INTENSE PORTION OF THE QLCS IN SERN KY/ERN TN INTO PARTS OF WRN NC AND SWRN VA/WV. LOCAL EXTENSIONS OF WW 275/276 HAVE BEEN COORDINATED AND PROBABILITY OF DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE INTO ADJACENT CWA/S IS AROUND 40 PERCENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A QLCS EXTENDS FROM ERN KY TO WRN GA...WITH THE MOST INTENSE PORTION OF THE LINE PER MID-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY AND LOW-LEVEL VELOCITY SIGNATURES ACROSS SERN KY INTO ERN TN. THIS PORTION OF THE LINE HAS A MORE FAVORABLE ORIENTATION TO THE DEEP-LAYER SWLYS. OVERALL INTENSITY HAS LIKELY PEAKED AS CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW HAS BEGUN TO SURGE FARTHER E OF THE REFLECTIVITY GRADIENT AND DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS IS ONLY WEAKLY BUOYANT. STILL...FORWARD MOMENTUM OF THE LINE...AIDED BY 40-50 KT 700 MB WINDS IMMEDIATELY ALONG IT...IN CONJUNCTION WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD FAVOR STRONG SURFACE WIND GUSTS UNTIL THE LINE DIMINISHES. THESE WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING TREE DAMAGE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AS THE QLCS HAS WEAKENED OVER GA...OVERALL SEVERE WIND/HAIL RISK HAS BECOME QUITE MARGINAL/LOCALIZED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITH THE SRN PORTION OF THE QLCS ALIGNED MORE PARALLEL TO DEEP-LAYER S/SWLYS...RELATIVE TO FARTHER N OVER THE CUMBERLAND PLATEAU...CONVECTION HAS WEAKENED SUBSTANTIALLY OVER THE PAST HOUR. AS THE STRONGER LOW/MID-LEVEL FLOW CURLS N/NEWD THIS EVENING...LITTLE APPRECIABLE INCREASE IS ANTICIPATED IN OVERALL LINE INTENSITY. AS SUCH...STRONG WIND GUSTS SHOULD REMAIN LOCALIZED AND ANY RISK FOR HAIL SHOULD BE MARGINAL. ..GRAMS.. 06/10/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT MAY INCREASE THIS EVENING AS STORMS CONTINUE TO MOVE INTO RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE NEAR THE DAKOTAS BORDER. SUPERCELL TORNADO POTENTIAL APPEARS HIGHEST OVER NERN WY DURING THE NEXT 30-90 MINUTES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE MESOANALYSIS PLACES A STALLED FRONTAL ZONE ACROSS THE NRN THIRD OF WY AND A LOW 50 MI NNW CPR. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD ACROSS WY THIS EVENING AND AID IN MAINTAINING A SEVERE THREAT THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS SEVERAL POCKETS OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...MOST NOTABLY OF WHICH IS LOCATED NEAR THE JOHNSON/CAMPBELL COUNTY LINE IN NERN WY. BACKED ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS AND MOISTURE ARE SUPPORTING A DISCRETE SUPERCELL WITH RECENT STRONG LOWER TO MID-LEVEL ROTATION. AROUND 20 DEG TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS AND A LONG HODOGRAPH WILL LEND A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY FOR A TORNADO...IN ADDITION TO A LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WITH THE STORM ENTERING CAMPBELL COUNTY. THE SEVERE THREAT FOCUS SHOULD SHIFT TOWARDS SPORADIC LARGE HAIL AND INCREASING SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WITH TIME THIS EVENING AS COLD POOLS CONSOLIDATE AND UPSCALE ORGANIZATION INTO A SMALL MCS AS THE ACTIVITY MOVES INTO WRN SD LATER THIS EVENING. ..SMITH.. 06/10/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALIZED TORNADO RISK HAS DEVELOPED ALONG A WEAK WARM FRONT. OVERALL THREAT SHOULD REMAIN LIMITED IN TIME AND SPACE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 23Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A WEAK WARM FRONT AROUND 25 N SLO TO 25 S BMG. A SMALL CLUSTER OF SHOWERS AND STORMS JUST SW OF BMG HAS HAD WEAK ROTATIONAL SIGNATURES ON RADAR AND APPARENT TORNADO REPORTS PER WFO IND. WITH THIS ACTIVITY RIGHT ALONG THE BOUNDARY...ENHANCED 0-1 KM SRH TO AROUND 200 M2/S2 PER IND VWP DATA HAS CLEARLY BEEN SUFFICIENT FOR A TORNADO RISK. STILL...THE LONGEVITY OF THIS THREAT SHOULD BE TEMPERED BY A MARGINALLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH THE BULK OF TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES AOB 6 DEG C/KM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY CONFINED IN SPACE...MOST LIKELY IN PARTS OF WRN WV AND SRN OH DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER EXTENSIVE QLCS HAS DECREASED IN OVERALL SIZE AND CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM SWRN OH INTO FAR SWRN VA. A 50 KT REAR-INFLOW JET PER JKL VWP DATA HAS SUPPORTED EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURES NEAR THE OH RIVER. THESE WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF STRONG WIND GUSTS /REF 44 KT MEASURED AT KHTS AT 0009Z/...ESPECIALLY WHERE SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAD WARMED INTO THE 80S EARLIER THIS AFTERNOON IN OH/WV. FARTHER NE...NEGLIGIBLE BUOYANCY PER 00Z PIT RAOB AND ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING SUGGEST THAT THE QLCS WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH IN SIZE WITH INTENSITY WANING AS WELL /ESPECIALLY AFTER 02Z/. ..GRAMS.. 06/11/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF STORMS OVER WRN SD WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO GROW UPSCALE INTO A MCS. THE MCS MAY POSE A CONTINUED THREAT FOR STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND THE POSSIBILITY FOR ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO IF THE MCS MAINTAINS ITS INTENSITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SUBJECTIVE SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES A STALLED FRONTAL ZONE FROM N-CNTRL SD SWWD AND INTERSECTING A BROKEN/DEVELOPING CONVECTIVE LINE NEAR THE BLACK HILLS. THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING HAS LED TO TEMPS FALLING INTO THE UPPER 60S AMIDST LOWER 50S DEWPOINTS. A 45 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY /0213Z/ MEASURED AT KRAP. MODIFYING THE 00Z RAP RAOB FOR 02Z SURFACE CONDITIONS AHEAD OF THE DEVELOPING MCS YIELDS AROUND 1400 J/KG MLCAPE. THE INFLUENCE OF THE ERN MT/ERN WY SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING TOWARDS THE REGION AND CONTINUED UPSCALE GROWTH AND ORGANIZATION OF THE CONVECTIVE BAND INTO A MCS AND STRONG CLOUD-BEARING SHEAR AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD ACT TO PARTIALLY OFFSET INCREASING CINH. AS A RESULT...SOME THREAT FOR STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL PROBABLY ENCROACH FROM THE WEST INTO THE MO RIVER VALLEY. UNCERTAINTY REMAINS REGARDING THE ERN EDGE OF THE SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT AND ASSOCIATED DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL INTO E-CNTRL SD.
